checks: The transverse Jacobian is 1/||v₀|| because v₀·e=1. The section heights lie in [−d,1], making h+L strictly positive on T. Using ℓ_B≤ℓ bounds each actual roof column by r_eℓ_B and then by its displayed dual lower estimate.

For λ>1 the affine map contracts the t coordinate toward −h, lowering both section endpoints, so the overlap length is [ℓ−(h+U)/λ]_+. Summing the decreasing barycentric coordinates with p_i>0, and keeping q₀(U), gives σℓ≤d+U. The ratio (h+U)/(d+U) decreases in U, giving the sharp zero-volume threshold σβ.

The inverse map increases t by (t+h)/(λ−1). It introduces constraints only for the positive directional facet coordinates. In the μ system the coefficient of μ₀ is positive for λ>σβ. The bound on μ₀ yields q₀<β, which restores all original q_i≥0. The rank-one determinant in the d independent coordinates is (λ−σ)/(λ−1), so the stated simplex scale gives the exact physical-volume ratio.

When σ>1 and λ>σβ the comparison ratio equals (1−cx)^d/(1−x), with c>1 and 0<x<cx<1, hence is strictly below one. In the remaining range β<λ≤σβ the exact zero overlap gives strictness. Exact-rational substitutions checked both formulas and their ratio, and source 5e5b642b770e6623 §§2–4 (3)–(9) gives the same constraints.

overlap.comparison: Uses the same T, e, t and physical transverse measure to lower-bound the roof via a projection estimate. It has no affine-overlap identity, exact W(λ), or strict pointwise comparison of overlaps across directions.
